caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular object with a light brown background, resembling a piece of fabric or textile. The composition is centered with a large, red horseshoe shape in the middle. Surrounding the horseshoe are green leaves and stems, with several flowers in pink, blue, and yellow colors scattered throughout. The flowers have circular centers, and the stems branch out symmetrically from the horseshoe. Along the border of the rectangle, there are more green stems with round pink and red flower buds and small cream-colored circular elements. The edges of the rectangle are slightly rough and frayed, and the drawing is set against an off-white or beige background. A signature is visible in small, neat writing near the bottom right corner of the rectangle.
title: Hooked Rug
